question: What optimal operating conditions were identified for the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation, and what purities and recoveries did they give?
expect: 10 kPa, 16 theoretical plates, feed on tray 11, mass reflux ratio 3.143, D/F 0.092; HQ purity 99.2%, CAT purity 99%, HQ recovery 98.5%, CAT recovery 97.8% (abstract)
rendered: The optimal operating conditions identified for the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation were: an operating pressure of 10 kPa, a reflux ratio of 3.143, and a feed stage at the 11th tray. Under these conditions, the overhead catechol purity reached 0.99, while bottoms hydroquinone purity achieved 0.992. Corresponding recovery rates were 98.5% (catechol) and 97.8% (hydroquinone), with a reboiler heat duty of 12.175 kW.
